scenes.title: Waterfront
scenes.image_prompt:
SCENE: A cobblestone market street in a small autumn town, mid 
afternoon, at the height of a harvest market.

A brick bookshop with tall lit windows and a gold-lettered sign 
reading RIVERBEND BOOKS anchors the right side of the frame, its 
shelves visible through the glass. Beside it a stone-fronted cafe with 
a striped awning and a hanging sign reading CORNER COFFEE. A red and 
white striped market canopy stands on the left over tables of 
pumpkins, gourds and preserves, with stacked hay bales and a wooden 
handcart loaded with squash. A chalkboard menu leans against a crate.

Thirty or more handcrafted figures fill the street, standing in small 
clusters, browsing tables, carrying baskets, talking in pairs. Iron 
lamp posts line the cobbles. Drifts of fallen leaves gather along the 
gutters and between the stones. A shallow stream runs behind a wooden 
railing on the far left, crossed by a low stone arch bridge, with more 
of the town receding uphill into soft focus beyond.

LIGHT: Late afternoon, warm and low. Golden daylight rakes across the 
cobblestones from the left, casting long soft shadows. The shop 
windows and street lamps are already lit, glowing warm amber against 
the cooler daylight. Bright but not harsh, with rich falloff into the 
blurred background.

CAST: One figure wears a dusty rose coat, the only cool pink in the 
frame, clearly distinct from the warm reds and rusts worn by others. 
She stands near the market canopy with her back half turned, partly 
hidden behind a stack of hay bales. Small in frame, not the focal 
point, and not centered.

CAMERA: Elevated three-quarter view, roughly forty degrees above the 
street, close in, as if leaning over a model railway table. Never at 
the figures' eye level. Shallow tilt-shift depth of field with the 
market stall and the near cobbles in sharp focus, the far end of the 
street and the bridge softly blurred.

MOOD: Busy, warm, generous. The best hour of the best day of the 
season, with the light already starting to go.
scenes.music_prompt:
Gypsy jazz, minor swing. Lead acoustic archtop guitar playing a
slinky chromatic descending melody, then fast single-note runs.
Second guitar driving hard la pompe rhythm, percussive and dry.
Upright bass vamping on a repeating figure, hypnotic, staying on
one chord. Fiddle takes the second solo with heavy bow attack.
D Phrygian dominant over a D7 flat 9 vamp, 104 BPM, swung. Dark,
tense, propulsive. The harmony never resolves, it just keeps
circling. Menacing rather than cheerful. Builds in intensity
without changing chord.

scenes.title: Campfire
scenes.image_prompt:
SCENE: A fire clearing on a wooded ridge above the town, at dusk.

A ring of rough grey stones encircles a small campfire burning low 
and bright at the center of a gravel clearing. Four handcrafted 
figures sit around it in weathered wooden Adirondack chairs, angled 
inward toward the flames, seated naturally with relaxed posture. A 
fifth figure sits slightly apart on a fallen log at the edge of the 
ring. A stack of split logs rests to one side, a battered tin coffee 
pot sits on a flat stone near the fire, and an iron lantern hangs 
unlit from a low branch.

The clearing is enclosed by pines and autumn maples in deep rust and 
amber, with mossy rock outcrops and drifts of fallen leaves across 
the gravel. Through a gap in the trees at the far edge of the frame, 
far below and softly out of focus, a few warm lit windows of the 
town are just visible, with the faint glow of a locomotive headlamp 
on the rail line beyond.

LIGHT: The campfire is the dominant light source and the scene is lit 
almost entirely by it. Warm orange light falls across the stones, the 
gravel, the chairs, and the figures' faces and hands, falling off 
quickly into darkness at the edges of the clearing. Long soft shadows 
stretch outward from the fire ring. Above the treeline the sky is 
deep dusk blue, the last cold light of the day, contrasting against 
the warm firelight below.

CAST: One figure wears a dusty rose coat, the only cool pink in the 
frame. She stands at the edge of the clearing near the stacked logs, 
half turned away, partially obscured by a chair back. She is small in 
frame and not the focal point.

CAMERA: Elevated three-quarter view, roughly forty degrees above the 
clearing, close in, as if leaning over a model railway table. Never at 
the figures' eye level. Shallow tilt-shift depth of field with the 
fire ring in sharp focus and the treeline and distant town softly 
blurred.

MOOD: Quiet, intimate, the end of the day. Warm but with an ache 
under it, the last good evening before the season turns.
scenes.music_prompt:
Solo fingerpicked acoustic archtop guitar, close-mic'd and intimate.
A single fiddle sustains a low drone far in the background, almost
inaudible. No bass, no drums, no piano. D minor, 58 BPM, free and
unhurried, slight rubato. Sparse, lots of space between phrases.
Very quiet dynamics throughout, never builds.

feeling: I think end of Summer and beginning of Fall there's something in the air about "a lot of things are gonna change, but it'll be beautiful even if new"
prompt: Museum-quality handcrafted miniature diorama, photographed as if it were a real physical scale model. Hyperrealistic miniature craftsmanship with meticulously detailed architecture, tiny handmade props, realistic wood grain, painted plaster, textured stone, brass, aged metals, woven fabrics, ceramic, glass, and miniature foliage. Every object feels tactile and hand-built rather than computer generated. Warm cinematic lighting with practical lamps, glowing windows, soft volumetric light, subtle bloom, rich golden highlights, and gentle shadows. Premium color grading featuring warm amber, honey, cream, walnut brown, muted greens, burnt orange, soft reds, and natural neutrals. No oversaturated colors. Tiny handcrafted human figures with realistic painted faces and clothing, posed naturally with subtle imperfections. Objects show slight wear and lived-in character instead of looking pristine. Highly realistic physical materials including glossy glass reflections, matte painted wood, textured brick, wet stone, polished brass, tiny leaves, moss, cloth fibers, and realistic weathering. The scene should look like an expensive handcrafted railway exhibition rather than a toy. Elegant composition with layered depth, atmospheric perspective, beautiful bokeh, soft reflections, believable scale cues, and premium commercial photography aesthetics. Calm, cozy, nostalgic, timeless, inviting, sophisticated, tactile, handcrafted, believable.
music_prompt:
1930s small-town acoustic jazz. Two to four players only, no
orchestra. Upright bass, brushed snare, archtop guitar, clarinet,
muted cornet, fiddle, upright piano. Instrumental, no vocals.
Recorded to shellac in a wooden room, ribbon mic warmth, faint tape
hiss, no modern reverb. Wistful but warm, minor sixths, unresolved
turnarounds.
